introHtml: Cotton luggage travel bags offer a soft, natural alternative to synthetic options, making them ideal for eco-conscious corporate giveaways or employee appreciation gifts. The Field & Co.® Classic 20" Duffel Bag exemplifies this category with its sturdy cotton construction and ample space for weekend trips. These bags accept screen printing or embroidery for a subtle, professional brand impression that stands out from typical nylon or polyester styles.
